UPDATE bot_accounts SET binding_config = jsonb_set(
            jsonb_set(
                COALESCE(binding_config, '{}'::jsonb),
                '{connector_control}',
                COALESCE(binding_config -> 'connector_control', '{}'::jsonb),
                true),
            '{connector_control,agentNativePermissionMode}',
            to_jsonb($2::text),
            true)
         WHERE bot_id = $1
